summary.zh: BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）评测与分析年度条目

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Role of demonstrations in the Evaluation Analysis area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Rethinking the role of demonstrations: What makes in-context learning work?”. The page names Sewon Min, Luke Zettlemoyer as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
